newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Tornado kills two in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Tornado kills two in Bangladesh.

text.p: At least two people were killed and about 100 injured when a tornado swept through parts of northern Bangladesh, government officials said on Sunday.

The swirling winds, which lasted only few seconds on Saturday, blew away a two-month-old baby from his mother's lap in the northern town of Bogra, 230 kilometres (138 miles) from the capital Dhaka, local officials said.
The officials said local people recovered the body of the boy from a nearby bush. The other victim was an old man who died when a tree fell on him near Bogra.
A similar tornado on Saturday also swept through the adjacent Pabna district, injuring at least 50 people and damaging houses and crops.
